principle.name: Unik Format Error
principle.rationale: Jangan asumsi konsistensi format. Selalu cek route handler individual.

principle.name: Three-Layer Isolation
principle.description: Selalu isolasi layer mana yg bermasalah sebelum menyimpulkan root cause. Route handler ≠ controller ≠ lib.
principle.rationale: Scraper error sering keliatan seperti controller error, padahal lib yg salah. Build gagal bisa karena JSDoc missing atau scraper runtime error.

principle.name: Cloudscraper Silent Failures
principle.description: cloudscraper bisa return 403 tanpa throw error. Selalu cek response.statusCode setelah request.
principle.rationale: Scraper terlihat sukses (no exception), tapi data kosong atau error page ter-parsing.

technique.name: Response Body Inspection
technique.usage: Baca response endpoint langsung via browser/curl
technique.guidance: Periksa: status code, response format, error message, missing fields

technique.name: Stack Trace Analysis
technique.guidance: Lihat file:line pertama di codebase sendiri (bukan node_modules)

technique.name: Build Output Inspection
technique.guidance: Lihat apakah scripts/generate-docs.js yg gagal → cek JSDoc tags

technique.name: Env Var Verification
technique.guidance: Lihat .env.example untuk required vars. Cek PURUBOY_PG_URL dan PURUBOY_ADMIN_KEY

failure.name: Scraper 403 Silent
failure.symptom: Endpoint return data kosong atau error page HTML
failure.diagnosis: Cek response.statusCode di kode scraper → kemungkinan 403 tanpa throw

failure.name: Error Format Mismatch
failure.symptom: Client expect { success: false } tapi dapat { status: 'error' }
failure.diagnosis: Kemungkinan ping.js atau route handler lain yg beda format

failure.name: Missing force-dynamic
failure.diagnosis: Cek export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic' di route handler

failure.name: Invalid JSON → 500
failure.symptom: POST endpoint return 500 tanpa error jelas

failure.name: Docs Build Gagal
failure.symptom: npm run build gagal di generate-docs

failure.name: DB Connection Silent Fail
failure.symptom: Endpoint DB-related error tanpa koneksi issue
failure.diagnosis: Cek PURUBOY_PG_URL env var — mungkin typo (bukan DATABASE_URL)
